purpose: Freeze a deterministic one-dimensional specific-total-enthalpy-change curve derived only from the checksum-tracked NASA Wind-US reference solution. Experimental exit Mach and total-temperature profiles are not used in the derivation and remain independent benchmark observations.

thermodynamic_reduction.formula: h0_eff(x) = cp_eff * [integral rho*u*T dy / integral rho*u dy] + [integral rho*u*0.5*(u^2+v^2) dy / integral rho*u dy]
thermodynamic_reduction.note: The same constant-cp reduction used by the one-dimensional solver is applied to the NASA reference fields. Chemical formation enthalpies and variable-composition cp are not silently imported into the reduced-order solver.

normalization.zone_scope: main combustor duct Wind-US zones 2 through 8
normalization.duplicate_policy: Axial stations duplicated at adjacent zone interfaces are grouped by x rounded to 12 decimal places and arithmetic-averaged before h0_eff is formed.
normalization.endpoint_policy: The first station is frozen at x=0 m and the final station is frozen at the source-backed geometry exit x=0.356 m; the raw extracted exit coordinate differs only by approximately 4.57e-8 m.

line_energy_closure.formula: Qdot_net_prime(cell) = mdot_1d * [Delta h0_eff(x_right) - Delta h0_eff(x_left)] / (x_right - x_left)
line_energy_closure.interpolation: piecewise-linear interpolation of the frozen Delta h0_eff curve at solver cell faces
line_energy_closure.conservation_property: The discrete integral sum(Qdot_net_prime * dx) equals mdot_1d * [Delta h0_eff(x_exit) - Delta h0_eff(x_start)] up to floating-point roundoff.
line_energy_closure.mass_flow_policy: mdot_1d is computed from the one-dimensional inlet state and inlet area. The closure therefore preserves the NASA reference solution's source-backed specific-energy change without forcing the one-dimensional mass flow to equal the two-dimensional reference mass flow.
line_energy_closure.sign_semantics: Signed net energy: positive adds energy to the gas; negative removes energy. It is not relabelled chemical heat release or measured Qdot-prime.

independence_and_claim_boundary: No experimental exit Mach point is used to construct Delta h0_eff or Qdot_net_prime.
No experimental exit total-temperature point is used to construct Delta h0_eff or Qdot_net_prime.
The closure is computational-reference-derived and may verify a reduced-order thermal/flow model only.
It does not validate finite-rate chemistry, species transport, or LBW/YBW classification.
